title: 못 한 이유 말하기: 일하느라고 못 갔어요
objective: By the end, you can attach -느라고 (-느라) to action verbs, including ㄹ-stem verbs, to explain why you couldn't do something. You will also know when to use -아서/어서 instead.
summary: Learn to use -느라고 to say that you were busy doing one thing, so something else went wrong or didn't happen.

task.title: Explain what went wrong
task.line: Use -느라고 where it fits. Where it doesn't fit, use -아서/어서 as shown in Watch Out.

forms.when: Action verb stems, with or without a final consonant (하다 → 하느라고, 먹다 → 먹느라고).
forms.means: I was busy doing A, so B went wrong (couldn't do it, was late, missed it).
forms.exampleMeaning: I was busy moving yesterday, so I couldn't answer the phone.

forms.when: Verb stems ending in ㄹ (놀다, 살다, 팔다, 만들다). The ㄹ drops before ㄴ.
forms.means: Same meaning: I was busy doing A, so B went wrong.
forms.exampleMeaning: I was busy hanging out with friends, so I couldn't do my homework.

forms.when: Same verbs, same meaning. Very common in speech and text messages.
forms.exampleMeaning: I was watching a drama, so I didn't get any sleep.

forms.when: Use this to say what is keeping you busy or tired.
forms.means: I'm busy (or it's hard) because I'm doing A.
forms.exampleMeaning: These days I'm really busy getting ready to move.

watchOut: 아프느라고 (X) → 아파서 (O): -느라고 only works with action verbs. With adjectives like 아프다, 춥다 or 바쁘다, use -아서/어서.
일했느라고 (X) → 일하느라고 (O): Never put the past tense before -느라고. Put it only at the end: 일하느라고 못 갔어요.
놀느라고 (X) → 노느라고 (O): ㄹ drops before -느라고 (살다 → 사느라고, 팔다 → 파느라고).
동생이 TV를 보느라고 제가 못 잤어요 (X) → 동생이 TV를 봐서 제가 못 잤어요 (O): Both parts of the sentence need the same person. If someone else did A, use -아서/어서.
exercises: Fill in the blank with the verb in brackets + -느라고: 아침에 아이 도시락을 ____ 회의에 늦었어요. (만들다)
Choose the correct form: 어제 손님을 (기다리느라고 / 기다렸느라고) 점심을 못 먹었어요.
Choose the ending that fits best. Use -느라고 where it fits: ① 날씨가 (춥느라고 / 추워서) 밖에 안 나갔어요. ② 친구와 (통화하느라고 / 통화해서) 버스를 놓쳤어요.
Correct or wrong? If it is wrong, fix it: ① 저는 발표를 준비하느라고 주말에 못 쉬었어요. ② 룸메이트가 음악을 듣느라고 제가 공부를 못 했어요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 메시지를 / 못 봤어요 / 운전하느라고
Answer in Korean. Use the words in brackets + -느라고: 어제 왜 모임에 안 왔어요? (보고서를 쓰다)
answers: ① Correct ② Wrong → 룸메이트가 음악을 들어서 제가 공부를 못 했어요.
보고서를 쓰느라고 못 갔어요. (보고서를 쓰느라 못 갔어요. / 보고서를 쓰느라고 못 왔어요.)
